en-US.description:
Hello everyone! This is Park Na-eon🤓

This is my first time on YouTube, so I'll share a bit of my daily life with you. Because of the number of edits, I even invited Choi Soo-jong. I couldn't bring myself to invite Ha Hee-ra (gasp!)!

I felt like there were limits to conveying the things I wanted to show you and the stories I wanted to tell through Instagram, so after much deliberation, I decided to open a YouTube channel. I'll share the various thoughts I've had while lying alone on the couch, the small but bright and joyful moments of my life, and the many things I want to share!

Please leave a comment with any content you'd like to see or any questions you have, and I'll show you everything step by step. Thank you for visiting my channel. I hope you're always happy😽😽😽

- Posted by Park Na-eon
